profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer and technical lead designing secure cloud platforms, APIs, and identity and reliability foundations for vulnerability-response, government, and defense systems. Provided technical leadership for Microsoft Security Response Center platforms and engineering delivery on Microsoft's $10B Department of Defense cloud contract. Known for translating cross-team architecture into reusable services, operational controls, and consistent delivery while coaching engineers on complex, mission-critical systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer and technical lead in MSRC, delivering secure applications and cloud platforms that help researchers and internal analysts investigate, report, and respond to software vulnerabilities. 
* Led delivery of containerized vulnerability-response services using React, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, GraphQL, and Cosmos DB, supporting external researchers and internal analysts across investigation, submission, and response workflows. 
* Led design and operation of the team's Azure Front Door, API Management, and Kubernetes platform and gated CI/CD, standardizing deployment, security scanning, testing, and release controls across repositories. 
* Created shared .NET foundations for configuration, telemetry, logging, and health checks, replacing duplicated service code and improving consistency across APIs and background services. 
* Led identity and authorization modernization across shared libraries and multiple APIs, standardizing authentication middleware, RBAC, claims handling, and production identity flows. 
* Led resolution of production incidents spanning GraphQL, token caching, service routing, Kubernetes, and Cosmos DB, restoring portal sign-in, submissions, and communications while strengthening monitoring and post-incident follow-through. 
* Helped lead phased production rollout of AI-assisted vulnerability-report analysis, implementing guarded exposure, shadow-mode quality gates, endpoint telemetry, and operational-readiness controls.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer on Microsoft's CST JEDI team, supporting a $10 billion Department of Defense contract for classified cloud capabilities. 
* Led engineering delivery on Microsoft's $10B Department of Defense cloud contract, building air-gapped infrastructure and applications to meet DoD security and compliance standards. 
* Modernized legacy platforms from .NET Framework 4.6 to .NET 5 and from Angular to React, meeting new national-security, accessibility, and audit requirements. 
* Standardized CI/CD, SQL deployment, logging, security controls, and release practices across commerce applications, improving reliability and delivery consistency.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
As product SME for COBRA, a highly flexible location-tracking and incident management platform, led advancement of core technology as well as creation of innovative features for the US Air National Guard, Jordanian Ministry of Health, and the Federal Government of Belgium, with account sizes ranging from $800,000 to $2M.
•	Migrated COBRA deeper into the cloud, shifting to .NET core, Angular, and then React to increase performance by 30~40%. Replaced MVC bundling with nodejs / webpack with drastic improvements in developer efficiency.
•	Developed iOS and Android mobile apps with powerful mapping functionality to empower field workers to capture and geo-tag images integrated into incident records – a key selling point for Dynamis.
•	Designed document management tools enabling users to scan, log, index, edit, and report documentation using a searchable database.
•	Architected back-end SQL integrations with third-party databases to enable real-time insights of location, inventory, and capacity of medical facilities, labs, industrial plants, and crisis centers.
•	Oversaw design, construction, and manufacturing of COBRA Locators, a compact, robust GPS unit with a reliable signal and extended battery life, used to track equipment, vehicles, and resources.
•	Internationalized application interface to support 10 languages, including Arabic and Hebrew (requiring right-to-left reorientation) in order to attract and retain a global customer base.
•	Supervised 15-person team of front- and back-end engineers while serving as resident DBA. Mentored junior developers, managed code reviews, and facilitated sprints and standups.
•	Implemented software development best practices such as Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, and containerization using Docker. Created internal project-management and bug-tracking tools.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Across a decade, transformed nascent COBRA technology from a VB thick client desktop app into a mobile-ready web services application, attracting new lucrative US contracts of 1,000+ seats with the FBI, the Vatican, various military bases, anti-terrorism and bioterrorism agencies, the Air National Guard, and the Winter Olympics.
TECHNOLOGY PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT
•	Developed ASP.NET MVC/SQL web app as side project, which easily outperformed the desktop app, became the go-to option for all clients, and served as a launchpad for moving into the cloud.
•	Spearheaded migration of issue-tracking software, servers, and databases to Azure, implemented Azure DevOps and CI/CD methods, and transitioned to cloud-based internal tools.
•	Created web services in REST to enable third-party app and data integration with clients existing technology systems – a key element to winning new contracts.
•	Managed annual upgrades to stay on the cutting edge, shifting from VB6 to .NET (C# and VB.NET), from .NET 1.1. to .NET 4 and beyond, from desktop apps to WPF, and from XML files to SQLite.
•	As a precursor to web app, built SQL replication architecture to power client-server communication and synchronization in order to unify real-time efforts of emergency-response teams in crisis mode.
TECHNICAL TEAM LEADERSHIP
•	Took leadership role over 5-10 developers, holding final decision-making on all engineering matters, managing weekly code reviews, and setting up peer mentorships to elevate team impact.
•	Served as lead developer for COBRA product, driving product releases and multiple upgrades, overseeing bug reporting, tracking, and fixes, and holding design meetings as needed.
•	Provided onsite support for large, high-visibility events such as the Brazil Olympics, Rock Werchter Festival in Belgium, and several Pope visits, often coding firmware and integration layers on the fly.
•	Facilitated engineering team’s transition to Dynamis upon the 2016 divestiture of the COBRA business unit.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected Ohio Law Enforcement Gateway Search Engine (OHLEG-SE), a web application used to aggregate criminal data from statewide agencies and departments into a single centralized repository accessed via web services. Trailblazed usage of global justice XML data model (GJXDM) used by law enforcement groups across North America.
•	Led creation and demonstration of an information-sharing network, which became the top revenue producer for the company and the go-to model used for other key accounts such as the FBI.
•	Drove 2.0 network upgrade, expediting load time 2X while doubling search results and boosting reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, coded, and built VB.NET/JavaScript/SQL financial/account management application (WIFTool+) to track funding and classified information for the 21 nation states making up the Partnership for Peace (PfP), a military-to-military coalition between NATO, Europe, and the former Soviet Union. Earned CSC Technical Achievement Award.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developer for Anti-Terrorism software project (CoBRA, Chemical and Biological Response Aide), used by the Department of Homeland Security, Department of Defense, FBI, local law enforcement, hazmat teams, universities, and the military
•	CoBRA 1.x built in Visual Basic 6 with an Access database, combining ActiveX controls
•	CoBRA 2.x upgraded to VB.NET and interfaces with a SQL database
•	Gave multiple demonstrations and aided in sales of CoBRA
•	Administrated and maintained company network
•	Performed QA on all software products to come out from DGI
•	Trained users on how to use CoBRA
•	Performed on-site duties, including 2002 Olympic Games, during which I developed and fielded a Bomb Management Center Call Tracking system critical to Responder support activities
•	Developed in-house customer management database
